title: WPCRL/346/2018 of Smt. Bebi AND ANOTHER Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
MCRC No. 101 of 2020 (Restoration Appl.)
CRMA No. 2509 of 2020 (Delay Condonation Appl.)
IN
WPCRL No. 346 of 2018
Hon'ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.

Mr. Parikshit Saini, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. G.S. Sandhu, learned G.A. for the
State of Uttarakhand.
Heard learned counsel for the parties
through video conferencing.
There is delay of 206 days in filing the
restoration application.
For the reasons stated in the delay
condonation application, the delay in filing
restoration application is hereby condoned.
Accordingly, delay condonation
application is allowed.
Also heard learned counsel for the parties
on the restoration application.
For the reasons mentioned in the
restoration application, the same is allowed.
Accordingly, the order dated 28.11.2019 passed
by this Court is hereby recalled and the writ
petition is restored to its original number
alongwith interim order.
Learned Government Advocate submits
that, upon completion of investigation,
Investigating Officer had prepared Final Report,
however, S.S.P., Haridwar ordered for further
investigation in the matter. He further submits
that the matter is now under investigation.
Having regard to the statement made by
learned Government Advocate, the writ petition
is disposed of and it is provided that the
protection granted to the petitioners vide order
dated 07.03.2018 shall continue to operate till
filing of report under Section 173 Cr.P.C. before
the Court concerned.
